records.title: France 2030 - PEPR GFM "Grands Fonds Marins" - Appel à projets - 2026

validation.notes: Agence nationale de la recherche (ANR) is the record's named official_source and the publisher of the scholarship page. The asset is ANR's institutional logo (2021 'complet' version, i.e. logotype with signature) declared on ANR's own official brand page 'Charte graphique et logo' as that page's og:image, and used as the header institutional logo on every anr.fr page. Direct GET returned HTTP 200, Content-Type image/png, 18350 bytes; a 3x retina variant anr-logo-2021@3x.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 34915 bytes) also exists. The official brand page states the principal logo is published at 1939x497 px, so this is not a low-resolution badge. records.title: ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship

validation.notes: The record's official_source is 'ILSC Language Schools' and the scholarship page is on the official domain www.ilsc.com. The asset is that page's own primary site logo, marked with alt text 'ILSC Language Schools and Greystone College', and the same file is reused in the ILSC Language Schools brand card further down the page. Direct GET returned HTTP 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, 9309 bytes. Confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the wordmark is a dual lockup 'ILSC Language Schools and Greystone College' (ILSC is a Greystone College School of Languages) rather than an ILSC-only mark; there is no official ILSC-only logo asset discoverable on ilsc.com. Vector SVG is a legitimate brand asset and not a favicon-sized badge.

examined: https://www.ilsc.com/hubfs/template-resources/images/internal/background/img_ls_selector.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 19853 bytes - same horizontal colour wordmark as raster, but served as an internal template background graphic for a campus selector widget)
https://www.ilsc.com/hubfs/Logos/ILSC_Education-Group_Vertical_Logo_White.png (HTTP 200, image/png, 57100 bytes - footer lockup, white-on-white variant)

rejected.reason: decorative hero photograph used as the page og:image, not a logo
